messages.author: aa2337615dcb4172
messages.subject: Fail to load rcdk
parts:
Greetings users,

Any known issues with rcdk? I'm getting the following error for just loading the library.

server.R:

library(rcdk)

error:

An error has occurred
The application failed to start.
The application exited during initialization.
Loading required package: rJava Loading required package: rcdklibs Loading required package: fingerprint Loading required package: png Loading required package: iterators Error: cannot allocate vector of size 217.8 Mb Execution halted

#########################



Thanks,

Andrew

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Fail to load rcdk
parts:
Works fine for me. I think you've hit the 2GB memory limit we've set
for R processes on glimmer/spark, probably because you have other
stuff floating around in your R session. Try restarting R and doing it
again.

-Winston
